QUOTE: `not_indexed` / `not_indexed_count`: in-scope file types that produced no rows, e.g. `.py=53`. These keys are present only if the build recorded them. A missing key means "not recorded", not "nothing was missed".
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the empty reply also names in-scope file types that produced no rows (`not_indexed`), distinguishing "not indexed" from "nothing was missed".
